controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: hazard report during routine operation on D-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on D-8210 and TT-8210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically preventing water ingress to hot material. D-8210 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during routine operation while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 March 2012 a hazard report was recorded on D-8210 and TT-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
